data.gender_notes: Vishwamitra is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who pervades the universe with his wisdom and knowledge. data.etymology: Vishwamitra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “All-pervading.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishwamitra total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_sanskrit.name: विष्वामित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विष् (vis) meaning all, विद् (vid) meaning knowledge, मित्र (mitra) meaning friend. So, Vishwamitra means 'all-knowing friend'.

in_hindi.name: विष्वामित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: सार्व (sarv) meaning all, ज्ञान (jñana) meaning knowledge, मित्र (mitra) meaning friend. So, विष्वामित्र (Vishwamitra) means 'friend of all knowledge'.

in_tamil.name: விஷ்வாமித்ர
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஷ் (viṣ) meaning all, அற்றையில் (arrtraiyl) meaning in all, விஜ்ஜியம் (vijjayam) meaning victory. So, விஷ்வாமித்ர (Vishwamitra) means 'victorious in all'.

in_telugu.name: విష్వామిథ్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్ఖర (sarvakara) meaning all-pervading, జ్ఞాన (jñana) meaning knowledge, మైత్ర (maitra) meaning friend. So, విష్వామిథ్ర (Vishwamitra) means 'all-knowing friend'.

in_marathi.name: Vishwamitra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishwamitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who pervades the universe with his wisdom and knowledge.

in_bengali.name: Vishwamitra
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishwamitra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who pervades the universe with his wisdom and knowledge.

data.cultural_impact: Vishwamitra is a revered sage in Hindu mythology, known for his vast knowledge and wisdom. He is considered a jagadguru, or a teacher of the universe. His name is a testament to his status as a revered figure who transcended boundaries and pervaded the entire universe with his wisdom, inspiring generations with his teachings and contributions to various aspects of Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Vishwamitra holds immense spiritual significance as it reflects the sage's deep understanding of the universe and spirituality. The prefix "Vishwa" means "Universe" or "All," and the suffix "mitra" means "Friend." This name signifies that Vishwamitra is a friend to all beings in the universe, a wise and compassionate guide, and a bridge between the divine and the human. His name is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things in the universe and the importance of wisdom, knowledge, and compassion in leading a spiritual life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vishwamitra: The all-pervading sage, whose spiritual depth and mastery over cosmic energies enabled him to transcend worldly limitations. A seer of the vast universe within and beyond, dedicated to the pursuit of enlightenment.

historical_references.context: Vishwamitra is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures including the Mahabharata and the Ramayana.
